title: Able such an empty word carries so much power an illusion of control an absence of action an othering of those with unicorn arms #smallpoems
summary: Able such an empty word carries so much power an illusion of control an absence of action an othering of those with unicorn arms #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Able
such an empty word
carries so much power
an illusion of control
an absence of action
an othering of those
with unicorn arms
#smallpoems
